responsibility: Declares Linux64-specific rs6000 options and variables. It defines the target-side -mprofile-kernel switch and the -mcmodel= enumeration for 64-bit Linux code models, providing the option metadata consumed by linux64.h override logic and the backend when selecting profiling style and TOC/addressing model.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-metadata side of the linux64 pair: it declares -mprofile-kernel and -mcmodel= values and their variables, whereas linux64.h contains the actual Linux64 target configuration, specs, and ABI logic that consume them.
